entries.title: Time‑Lapse Tree Growing from a Seed
entries.description: A small seed sphere in soil slowly sprouts a transparent green shoot that lengthens, thickens, and branches upward into a tree, with leaves attaching over time and a floating time‑slider bar controlling growth speed and labels for root, stem, and canopy.

entries.title: Root Network Expansion Underground
entries.description: A plant stem above ground stays mostly stationary while semi‑transparent roots branch, split, and slowly snake through a light‑brown soil volume, colliding with and wrapping around rock spheres, with nutrient particles flowing along roots and changing color where they are absorbed.

entries.title: Phototropism: Plant Bending Toward Moving Light
entries.description: A flexible plant stem composed of connected segments gradually bends and rotates toward a moving glowing “sun” sphere in the sky, with arrows and color gradients along the stem showing differential growth on the shaded vs. lit side.

entries.title: Vine Climbing a Rotating Pole

entries.title: Clonal Spread of Grass via Underground Rhizomes

entries.title: Climbing Ivy Covering a Wall Surface
